snippet.title: We Made a Flying Car Arcade Game (And It's Ridiculous)
snippet.description:
▶ Play free in your browser: https://aristudios.fr/roadster-race/

Your car can fly. A unicorn is driving it. Your style rank is D. Let's fix that.

Roadster Race is a free-to-play arcade game about flying cars, made with way too much synthwave and a few questionable decisions:
🚀 Take off and boost
🌀 Barrel rolls, purely for style (from D to S)
🌆 4 circuits: Neon, Grid, Tokyo and the Demo, where a rocket may launch right next to you
🦄 24 skins: Unicorn, Doge, 24 Karat, crypto ones, etc.
💥 Crash hard enough and someone yells "YOU'RE FIRED!"

Plays in your browser. No download, no account needed, desktop and mobile.

A parody inspired by a certain roadster launch. Not affiliated with any billionaire, rocket company or car brand.

Made by Ari Studios, independent game studio.

#indiegame #browsergame #synthwave
